** Jonny’s Team Needs YOU 🫵
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Friend,

It’s hard to believe that 25 years have passed since September 11, 2001. For those of us who lived through that day, the memories can still feel remarkably close, where we were, who we were with, and how the world seemed to change in an instant. For Jonny, those memories are especially personal, tied to his time serving with the US Marine Corps in Washington, D.C. As we mark this anniversary, he reflects on what he witnessed that morning, the service and sacrifice that followed, and the sense of unity Americans shared in the days after.

Read the press release (https://jonnyutah4congress.com/latest-news/press-releases/september-11-2026-remembrance-press-release?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=3eb1ca602f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=3eb1ca602f&mc_eid=UNIQID) , or watch Jonny share his memories and some memorabilia here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=emLtrA_Cw6A&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=3eb1ca602f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=3eb1ca602f&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The AI Panic Hits Fever Pitch and Trump Trashes Paxton
body:
Plus, Gregg Hull isn't in his own running mate's ad | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/7v8dGUz5U0B?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Two things this week we couldn't stop talking about. A researcher quit Anthropic and said the people building AI think it could end all of us inside ten years, and his own boss backed him up on it publicly. [Then closer to home,](https://us.list-manage.com/10hPpCqI_Yq?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) the Republican candidate for lieutenant governor ran an ad that somehow never mentions the guy running for governor.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Sum4o5nfwZQ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🔥 **THE RESEARCHER WHO QUIT ANTHROPIC

** Jacob Coxon walked out two months before his stock vested, which means he left real money on the table to say what he said. And what he said is that the people building this stuff already believe it could end us inside about ten years. They're just a lot more honest about it in private than they are in public.Then his own boss at Anthropic got online, said Coxon's right!

Krysty thinks he's the real thing. He said flat out he'd have stayed if he believed the guardrails were coming, and that landed with her. Mark isn't buying it, because the Wall Street Journal already had the story before Coxon ever hit send.

💵 **MARK THINKS THIS IS ABOUT MONEY**
Anthropic's about to go public at something close to two trillion dollars. Mark’s read is that if Washington ends up blessing a handful of approved AI companies, those companies get legal cover and everybody else gets shoved out of the business. It's a pretty good deal if you're one of the handful.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/MP60vBD8AHq?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 🏛️ **THE AD WITH NO GREGG HULL IN IT**
David Gallegos is running for lieutenant governor, and this week he dropped a digital ad going after Deb Haaland on guns. Gregg Hull, the guy actually running for governor, isn't in it. Anywhere.
Here's Mark's problem with it. Most people in this state still couldn't pick Gregg Hull out of a lineup, so every dollar spent making voters familiar with David Gallegos is a dollar that didn't go toward the top of the ticket. He also doesn't think guns are the fight to pick in a New Mexico general election, and he says what he'd be running instead.

💰 **TRUMP PROMISED YOU $5,000. THEN HE WENT AFTER KEN PAXTON.**
From the stage in Dallas, five thousand dollars for every adult in America if Republicans hold the House and Senate. We vote Republican and we still think it's the wrong call, and Mark gets into what he'd rather see done with that kind of money.
Trump was also there to campaign for Ken Paxton. To help him. Which is what makes the thing he said about Paxton from that same stage so hard to believe.

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life 's mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he's determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe's entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he's determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same. Joe's entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy. During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met. subject: Yesterday’s rally in Athens

body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2867%2E5691347%2E7O_btB)

Yesterday, I rallied a massive crowd in Athens to organize opposition to the Trump administration and my opponent, Mike Collins.
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-sep26-athens.hgJNzd&refcode=em260914-2-subs&t=2&akid=2867%2E5691347%2E7O_btB)
[**(You can watch my speech here.)**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-sep26-athens.H4SZra&refcode=em260914-2-subs&utm_campaign=em260914-2-subs&t=3&akid=2867%2E5691347%2E7O_btB)
Here's what I said:
Hello, Athens!
Now Athens, the polls open in one month. One month ‘til early vote. One month ‘til you can cast your ballot to save our Republic. Athens, turn to your neighbor and say, “One month.” Say, “Lock in.” Because Athens, the country's counting on us again.
And the crowds I've seen over the last year at rallies like this one and in backyards and living rooms across our state and the army of volunteers already knocking tens of thousands of doors each week all leave no doubt that Georgia's about to make history again.
Athens, are you ready to win?
Now, I know many of you are here today because you just can't stand what's been done to our country. Our whole government made a corrupt tool of one man's vengeance and power and wealth.
The president’s critics prosecuted or bullied off the airwaves. Prices soar while the president rakes in billions. Cancer patients lose insurance while the rich get another tax cut.
We sink in the quicksand of reckless war as immigrant families are torn apart, and private prisons grow in size and in squalor. The Justice Department and even our intelligence services are twisted to serve the president's vendettas.
But in one month, Athens, we will vote to rebuke him so decisively no president will dare such abuses again for centuries. In one month, we’ll vote to defeat the bigot congressman, Trump puppet Mike Collins.
In one month, our juggernaut Democratic coordinated campaign will get out the vote to elect Josh McLaurin, Penny Brown Reynolds, Tanya Miller, and Democrats up and down the ballot across our state. And Athens, in one month we'll vote to elect a Medicaid-expanding Governor Bottoms and end our state’s health care emergency.
And between now and then, Athens, we need you to work, not for my sake, but for the sake of our state and our country. Because some people just happen to live at times and in places where history is made. And this year, once again, that's us.
Now remember, Trump promised to lower prices on day one. But last week, the broken old man threw a two-day party in Texas, while it costs more than ever to fill up your truck, to stock your fridge, and to power your home. Under the failed President Donald J. Trump, food, diesel, and health care all just hit their all-time highs.
They doubled your insurance premiums and slashed Medicaid to cut taxes for their corporate donors and the ultra-rich.
They made you pay more for everything.
They lied us into war and spent most of the last year covering up for the world's most famous pedophile.
All while the crook president and his crook family raked in billions from all over the world.
He promised to lower prices on day one, and he also promised peace. Instead, the draft-dodging commander-in-chief builds a monument to himself while plunging us deeper into a war he doesn’t know how to end or how to win. The biggest foreign policy debacle since Iraq.
And once again, it’s a war based on lies.
Remember, last year they claimed Iran's nuclear program had been obliterated. Do you remember that? And then this year, they claimed that same nuclear program posed an imminent threat.
Both times lies.
On day four of the war, the president declared victory.
On day 11, Trump said, "The war is very complete."
Day 13, "We won."
Day 21, "Getting very close."
Day 32, "Leaving very soon."
On day 40, the president declared, "Total and complete victory."
And this Wednesday will be day 200.
18 Americans are dead and hundreds wounded. The president calls this “small potatoes.” Iran still has its uranium and its drones and its missiles, and Hormuz is still closed. They drained our stockpiles to achieve nothing. And while Pete Hegseth squanders our military power, his Pentagon funnels your money to the First Family.
Just listen to this: five days after his father was reelected, Prince Don Jr. becomes a partner at 1789 Capital, a venture firm founded by right-wing activists and Trump donors. 1789 Capital then buys a stake in Vulcan Elements, a tiny startup that says it plans to produce the high-tech magnets needed in drones, missiles, and satellites.
And about a month after Don Jr.’s venture firm buys its stake in Vulcan Elements, Pentagon officials learn that Peter Navarro — a convicted criminal, Don Jr.’s close friend, and a top White House official — wants the Pentagon to give your tax dollars to Vulcan Elements. One Pentagon official said, "The call came from the White House: We have to get this done."
And, Athens, to be clear, "getting this done" means funneling your money to the president’s son’s investment.
And so of course, like clockwork, on November 21st, just three months after Don Jr. and his friends bought their stake, Vulcan gets a $620 million taxpayer loan from Pete Hegseth's Pentagon, paid for with your money.
See, while the world burns and you pay more for everything, your tax dollars become the royal family’s wealth.
Because it pays to be a Trump, especially when the whole world knows daddy's a crook.
Half a billion from the Emirati spy chief to the Trump family crypto business, months before the administration granted the Emirates access to our most sensitive AI chips.
$1.6 billion of your money backing the Trump boys' mining interests in Kazakhstan. Jared Kushner on the Saudi payroll while he pretends to lead our Middle East diplomacy. And on and on.
The Mar-a-Lago mafia really has taken American corruption to spectacular new heights. But Athens, corruption in American politics runs a lot deeper than Donald Trump. And, see, I get why people voted for him. Because even before he came on the scene, American politics was coin-operated.
Money goes in, favors come out. It's been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money. Both sides.
And when members of Congress aren't fundraising from lobbyists and corporate PACs, they're trying to dodge getting bombed by these Super PACs. Spectacular wealth buys an ever-greater share of power over our national affairs. And this corruption is why nothing works for ordinary people.
It's why you pay a fortune for prescriptions. It's why your insurance company gets away with denying your cancer treatment after you paid your premiums for decades.
So Trump promised to attack a broken system. I get it. Ripe target. Yes, the system really is rigged. But he's not unrigging it; he's re-rigging it for himself.
So, how do we unrig American politics? Well first, we follow the money. See, _Citizens United_ was the most destructive Supreme Court decision in modern American history.
And Donald Trump's rise is a symptom of this deeper disease. And I suspect many of you are here because you recognize that our task is not just to contain his wickedness, but to cure the rot that gave rise to it. That this moment, this broken moment, is an opening not for restoration, but for reformation.
Because who really supports allowing unlimited, secret political money to bend the nation’s agenda in darkness?
In Athens or Albany or Columbus or College Park, if I asked anyone — Democrat, independent, Republican, none of the above — if I asked them whether this is how things should work, it doesn't matter who they are, the answer is no.
So let the defenders of secret corporate money in politics come out and defend it. They’ll lose the debate.
And Athens, if it takes a constitutional amendment to end _Citizens United_ , we'll deliver a united Georgia to ratify it.
_A united Georgia._ Every day our wave grows taller and our tent grows bigger. Because this isn't just a campaign for Democrats. Folks come up to me at airports or on the street. They tell me they’re lifelong Republicans but this year they’re voting for a Democrat for the first time.
Down in Valdosta, the mayor's named Scott James Matheson, a lifelong conservative Republican. We expanded Valdosta's transit system together. We upgraded Moody Air Force Base together.
When Hurricane Helene hit, I called him up in the middle of the night to check on the city. When the storm cleared, I was there alongside him going block by block to help. We served hot meals to folks who had just lost their homes.
And when I got back to Washington, I delivered federal disaster relief for South Georgia. And now I'm honored to have conservative Republican Mayor Matheson's support in this reelection campaign.
See, just about every week I dial up Georgia mayors and pastors and farmers to find out how I can help. And one day, I called up Mayor Julie Smith, just up the road from Valdosta, in Tifton.
Mayor Smith's a Republican, too. She told me the Tifton hospital needed new dialysis equipment. She explained how Tifton's dialysis center serves 12 South Georgia counties, and they just couldn't meet the need.
So I delivered the funds to upgrade that South Georgia clinic, and now it can serve 200 dialysis patients. And Republican Mayor Julie Smith is backing this campaign too.
Up north in Toccoa, then-mayor Gail Fry, another Georgia Republican, told me Toccoa's gas lines were wearing out. And a leak could risk lives. We needed to get moving quick to replace miles of old pipes. So I delivered the funds for Toccoa's new gas lines, and Georgia Republican Gail Fry is backing this campaign too.
Because, see, hurricanes and diabetes and gas leaks don't check party affiliation when they hit. And when it comes to serving Georgia, I don’t either.
But there's another reason so many Republicans are backing our campaign, and it's the bigot Congressman Mike Collins, who's only a congressman because his daddy was a congressman, surrounded at work and at home by neo-Nazis and white nationalists.
See, Brian Kemp was right about Mike. There's a reason Rick Jackson won't commit to campaigning with Mike. Why Brad Raffensperger refuses to endorse him. Why conservative WSB radio host Shelley Wynter called Mike a "bottom feeder."
Why Coach Dooley condemned Mike's "blatant, taxpayer-funded corruption" and said Mike's "disgusting behavior does not represent Georgia values or frankly, any values." Why Erick Erickson said Mike "knowingly hired a sociopath with a criminal record who is alleged to have used your and my tax dollars to subsidize his girlfriend."
There's a reason one of the founders of the Tea Party said this summer, "I cannot in good conscience vote for Mike Collins. He is unfit for office," and warned that Collins would "drag down the whole Republican ticket in Georgia."
And that reason is Mike Collins is a known bigot under federal investigation for the illegal misuse of tax dollars, widely known for his poor character and low integrity, and unfit for any elected office in the United States. And Athens, now the bigot wants a promotion. But this year we’ll end his political career instead.
An hour up the road from here is St. Mary's Hospital in Lavonia. It's in Mike's district. And they just closed their maternity unit, citing the Medicaid cuts Mike Collins voted for in order to fund tax cuts for the rich.
So now, thanks to Mike Collins, delivering mothers Mike Collins represents have to drive an hour in labor to get to a labor and delivery unit in a state where we've already lost 21 hospitals in 20 years.
Where life expectancy if you're born today in the state of Georgia is shorter than if you were born today in Lebanon. Where, thanks to Donald Trump and Mike Collins and their attacks on the Affordable Care Act, 300,000 Georgians lost their health insurance this year, and a million saw their premiums double.
Now, what could drive a man, even one as spoiled and hateful as the congressman's son, Mike Collins, to cast a vote that closes a labor and delivery unit in his own district or doubles his own constituents' insurance premiums?
It's not just the money that's corrupted our politics. It’s a moral corruption — the cynical indifference of powerful people.
See, my office is known for world-class service. And what amazes me is how surprised people are to be treated well.
Nancy Lancy is 81 years old in Jesup. Her husband died after years of dementia. She was worn out and alone, and now her affairs as a widow were all wrapped up in this bureaucratic labyrinth, from the VA to the IRS and Social Security. So we took care of things for her. And I'll never forget what she said about it. She said, "This was a new experience, to have someone caring about me."
"A new experience, to have someone caring about me."
How has it come to pass that for so many Americans, the experience of genuine care is rare and surprising?
Official indifference and corporate disrespect have become systemic. When millions are just one medical bill, short paycheck, or bad alternator from disaster, you work harder and harder but the treadmill gets faster and steeper and the bills get higher and higher. A 60-hour workweek still needs SNAP, or that bucket list trip is off the table for good.
And then, instead of reading your daughter her favorite book, that precious spare hour after work you're on the phone begging the insurance company to cover the medicine that prevents her seizures. The Army lost the records you need to claim your VA benefits, and it takes a year and twelve calls to fix it.
You report the black mold to your landlord, who doesn't fix the leak, and the ambulance for your toddler's asthma is followed by a $3,000 bill.
And it’s the worst for the most vulnerable.
Maybe you saw my investigation of Georgia foster care. In just four years, hundreds of Georgia children likely sex trafficked while in state care. Many more abused and neglected. Children in the care of the state.
Rachel Aldridge testified about her two-year old daughter, Brooklynn. See, over Rachel's repeated objections, DFCS had placed two-year-old Brooklynn in the care of her father and his girlfriend, despite their criminal histories.
State officials ignored Rachel's pleas. They skipped mandatory background checks. And two months later, Rachel's precious, perfect, irreplaceable two-year old girl was dead.
When she testified before my committee, Rachel said she'd flown on an airplane for the first time in her life just so she could tell senators her story. She begged us, "Please remember Brooklynn."
Tiffani McLean-Camp entered foster care at 15. She testified she was moved 20 times in three years, went eight months without a visit from a caseworker in a locked psychiatric facility where she was forcibly injected with sedatives, and was housed in group homes where staff used drugs, and she was sexually assaulted.
She testified her newborn son spent three weeks in the NICU and the next six weeks of his new life in a homeless shelter because DFCS couldn't find them a placement, while Tiffani went six months after delivery without seeing an OB-GYN.
Listen to this: Georgia DFCS is so broken that when they couldn't find enough placements for kids with special needs, juvenile court judges testified that the DFCS commissioner tried to lock those kids up in jails for children, but the judges refused and reported it to my office.
They tried to put special needs kids in jail.
And then when my investigation brought all this to light, when we held Senate hearings and exposed it all, instead of resigning, or at least leaping into action to fix it, state officials retreated into denial and PR and counterattack. Because foster kids don't have lobbyists, or a Super PAC.
Neither do the women subjected to medical abuse in ICE detention. Neither do the female inmates sexually abused by the warden and the chaplain in their federal prison. Or the young military family neglected by the defense contractor with a fifty-year lease on privatized housing at Ft. Gordon.
But they deserve leaders who see them and expose those who abuse them. And that’s exactly what I’ll keep doing. Because we’re all in this together.
Every day, I think about Congressman Lewis. His portrait hangs right above my desk in my Senate office.
And even in his final moments, he kept reminding us that we all live in one American house. That we all live in one world house. Do you remember? John Lewis called it "the inevitable truth that we're all members of one human family."
And I suspect many of you are here today, because you're so deeply troubled by the pain that so many of our fellow human beings are enduring right now.
The terror of a child watching ICE take away his mother. The despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment. The silent panic of a grandmother when she sees the receipt for her groceries and then remembers there's three weeks left until her next Social Security check.
And that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, don’t ignore that. Don’t just keep scrolling. Feel it, turn it into action. Because that feeling is what reminds us we're all human, that we're not just one United States, we're one united people. _E pluribus unum._ Out of many, one.
That feeling is what spurred thousands to lace up their shoes and march alongside John Lewis. It’s what channeled the Great Depression into retirement security and a minimum wage and it’s what fueled the Georgia patriots who stood up to a tyrannical king in Savannah and at Kettle Creek.
How inspiring, that the most powerful nation on Earth proclaims as its core values that all are created equal, with inalienable rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
See, Americans aren’t a race. We're a people. United, not by ethnicity, but by shared convictions and that is what makes us exceptional and a beacon to the world.
And see, this is what small men like Donald Trump and Mike Collins will never understand — that our national greatness flows not through our blood or our genes, but through our ideas and our aspirations and our care for one other.

Because Athens, I refuse to leave my girls a world as dark and dangerous and cruel as this one threatens to become. And I can’t stop thinking about it. I refuse to accept that Eva and Lila will grow up with artificial friends and teachers in a society where the sick die, not because there’s no cure, but because they have no money. On a poisoned planet, rearming for world war, where human life is cheap and might makes right. See, when Eva's old enough to ask me why I let this happen, I'm determined to answer truthfully that I didn't. I'll tell her how the same year she turned five, Georgia overcame every doubt and dirty trick not just to win, but to set a new course for our state and our country and our world. That our generation didn't shrink from its obligations to hers. That instead, we came together, clear-eyed about the stakes and what was required of us. We protected the sanctity of the vote from those who attacked it. That we elected those who understood the moment and had the will to meet it. That we restored American leadership toward peace and human rights, guaranteed health care for every citizen. And mastered technology instead of letting it master us. That we ensured each generation achieves greater health and prosperity than the last and lived up to the promise of equal justice for all. We can and will do these things, and it starts with victory in Georgia. Because Athens, our power is right there, just waiting for us to pick it up. And a wave is building. The kind of wave that comes once a generation, when people have been pushed too far and they decide all together, all at once, to say enough is enough. The polls open in one month, Athens. Are you ready to work? Are you ready to win? Thank you, God bless you, let's get it done together. Thank you so much Athens. 👋 Wait! Before you go... 👋 Jon Ossoff in Georgia is the ONLY Democratic Senator running for reelection in a state Trump won. He is MAGA's #1 target in the 2026 midterms. | | | Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate

Hi Peter, **The Supreme Court just blocked the Trump administration from putting new USPS restrictions on mail-in ballots into effect before the November election. This is a victory for our democracy!** **After the last Supreme Court ruling, I co-led the coalition of 25 states in taking the USPS to court. We quickly secured a lower court order blocking Trump’s rule before it could disrupt our elections** by requiring states to make sweeping changes to their mail-in voting systems on an incredibly short timeline. This is an important victory for voters in Washington and across the nation. The Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration’s attempt to put its new mail-in ballot restrictions into effect, leaving in place the lower-court order that allows Washington to continue using its established process for administering our primarily mail-based elections this November. Friends, Have you seen any of those really catchy “5 for $5” fundraising emails – the ones that give you 5 reasons why you should donate $5? Well we’re officially 50 days out from Election Day, and I bet we could easily come up with 50 reasons why we need to win on November 3rd. **But this isn’t one of those emails – instead, I’ve got ONE really good reason why the next 50 days matter so much: the results of the midterms will drastically affect how the rest of Trump’s presidency goes.**_(That’s another 735 days until the next presidential election, and another 74 days after that when Trump finally leaves the White House – but who’s counting?)_ **[If that’s enough of a reason for you to chip in to my re-election campaign, you can do so by clicking here – or keep reading for more details.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139208301/646622861/-642992695?amount=50&refcode=260914em_sjj_50days&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTJjYzg0My1hNGIwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uJdYy70MZ8LVCci9bRZAj3KN-299gcu68jPlzlE9COc=)** What we do right now makes a big difference in whether we win or lose on November 3rd – and _that_ determines everything that happens next. What we can get done, how we can fight back, and ultimately, the trajectory of our country for the next two years. We have the agency to decide where we spend our time, energy, and resources, and to channel that all into action. I know we can deliver a massive blue wave and start to make real progress on the issues we care about — if we keep the momentum going through Election Day. _So here’s how we do it: My team set a goal to raise another $10,000 online by tomorrow night to help us stay on track for our FEC deadline at the end of the month._ On September 30th, we have to file a public campaign finance report detailing everything we raised this quarter. These reports matter more than most people realize: strong numbers can lead to additional support, positive press coverage, and larger investments from allies. Weak reports can do the opposite — they can extinguish momentum and give opponents a reason to make additional investments in these final weeks. **And because my seat has been made more competitive under California’s new congressional maps, this FEC filing at the end of the month is our most important yet. ** [**So please, will you join me and invest whatever amount you can to help us hit our $10K goal and set us up for success in these final weeks?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139208302/646622862/-642992695?amount=50&refcode=260914em_sjj_50days&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTMxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTJjYzg0My1hNGIwLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uJdYy70MZ8LVCci9bRZAj3KN-299gcu68jPlzlE9COc=)

clean_body: What happens in the next 50 days will determine everything that comes after| | | | = Friends, Have you seen any of those really catchy “5 for $5” fundraising emails – the ones that give you 5 reasons why you should donate $5? Well we’re officially 50 days out from Election Day, and I bet we could easily come up with 50 reasons why we need to win on November 3rd. But this isn’t one of those emails – instead, I’ve got ONE really good reason why the next 50 days matter so much: the results of the midterms will drastically affect how the rest of Trump’s presidency goes.(That’s another 735 days until the next presidential election, and another 74 days after that when Trump finally leaves the White House – but who’s counting?) = What we do right now makes a big difference in whether we win or lose on November 3rd – and that determines everything that happens next. What we can get done, how we can fight back, and ultimately, the trajectory of our country for the next two years. We have the agency to decide where we spend our time, energy, and resources, and to channel that all into action. I know we can deliver a massive blue wave and start to make real progress on the issues we care about — if we keep the momentum going through Election Day. So here’s how we do it: My team set a goal to raise another $10,000 online by tomorrow night to help us stay on track for our FEC deadline at the end of the month. On September 30th, we have to file a public campaign finance report detailing everything we raised this quarter. These reports matter more than most people realize: strong numbers can lead to additional support, positive press coverage, and larger investments from allies. Weak reports can do the opposite — they can extinguish momentum and give opponents a reason to make additional investments in these final weeks. Hi, it’s
Chris.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: We have a problem on our hands
body:
In Senate races, the higher spender wins 80% of the time.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1333&source=&t=1&akid=3457%2E124072%2EuJ1MCe) | | | |

Peter,
[**_Before I ask you to chip in $5 before tonight’s critical mid-month deadline,_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1333&amount=5&t=8&akid=3457%2E124072%2EuJ1MCe) I have a really good reason why:
**In U.S. Senate elections, the side that invests more wins 80% of the time.**
If this trend persists in North Carolina’s race, then we’ve got a problem on our hands.
With Senate control hinging on our state, **we’re already being outspent** by my GOP opponent Michael Whatley and his super PAC allies. Since they opened up the floodgates with over $100 million of ads attacking me on the airwaves, my slim lead in the polls has tightened.
_Some polls show this race is now a statistical tie._
Given the millions more coming to Whatley’s aid from a super PAC with direct ties to President Trump’s MAGA Inc. PAC, my razor-thin lead could soon be wiped out entirely.
**If we don’t build the resources we need to respond in equal measure, all signs point to us losing on election night. If that happens, Republicans keep Senate control until 2029.**
Unlike Whatley, I’m not relying on billionaire and corporate megadonors to come to my rescue. My ability to fight back and flip North Carolina blue will come down to grassroots support from people like you.

---
I’m expecting a phone call from my defense attorney at any moment.
---
Any day now, the left-wing Attorney General of Arizona will shut a heavy door, lock out the public, and seat 16 anonymous strangers in a room.
---
**_No judge._**
---
**_No cameras._**
---
**_No face-to-face._**
---
**_No chance to defend myself._**
---
The Attorney General will walk away with the **NEW** sham **INDICTMENT** she needs to start a _BRAND NEW TRIAL_ against me with the goal of imprisoning me for 20 YEARS.
---
This is what has become of our country: **_Imprisoning an innocent man to win re-election!_**
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDB9AAwAAAAAAvWD4VyelVDGdYiVx4hSQgkkdMv2O75ak6sb51e-OFfnsKfKAyJ_CfKEEI_CNWjlS9I3r6so-k3AmkYEyssCdtBRrbCgtl8ebuJQe6zMXA)
__
---
Look at everything they’ve done to me so far:
---
_A dawn raid on my home.
Arresting me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Freezing my bank accounts.
Seizing my assets.
Forcing me to the point of bankruptcy. _
---
The lunatic Left’s desire to DESTROY yours truly knows no bounds.
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
But what I’ve come to realize ever since I came so close to death was that the pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**They can strip me of all I’m worth – _all I’ll ever be worth_ – but what I _REFUSE_ to surrender to the Democrats and their Deep State thugs is my LEGACY!**
---
And __that__ is what my final trial is truly all about, Friend.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”**
---
_"_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul_?" (Mark 8:36)_
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can _NEVER_ _AGAIN_ happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I’ve got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU_._
---

---

---
| **Incite a violent insurrection?** _The president has complete criminal immunity._
---
| **The court is handing the most criminal and treasonous president in American history near unlimited power.** SCOTUS is inching closer and closer each day to effectively appointing Trump a dictator, and it’s bringing our Democracy to the brink.
---
| When Democrats regain control of the House, Senate, and Presidency, _we will have little choice._ To save our democracy, we will need to **expand the number of Justices on the Court** and restore a balanced, nonpartisan, pro-democracy Court.
---
| _It’s not a radical idea._ The number of justices on the Court has changed _seven times_ before. Congress has the authority to do it again, **no constitutional amendment needed** , just a bill passed by the House and Senate and signed into law by the president.

| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015FotbGx1_ZN3SHNYy-DHPuRQ_hFArdDN3lu0QEUkhQeOvQHUmk2CTWEylWMIf_MWwPhX46hYfnuVdTYdxzS3MvkrxjFOSnKDTNHooFt9RqK3iTxwpda4DL2MZMpTNfXscmLvtklBv2z6qsmaUOVL3pqcR92X6Zw-e5de2cTg0aC55UcuNE4EbKNFQFGGkduIcwbHwtRxO88p76gGUp5RVuhICWAYppRjvUVkTDAW-74OFtapS2vO8I_zxW7RlLEyPtZ01a-v8hA=&c=dzk4hvhKlLMHU9qHCAfAQKcsOlCmQwTQsMxDHhI90I6i7P15Xese-g==&ch=ceOwXF6g9wCWxYiwY_wy3JQKGSNJpVQ5emODOaWaq-aBwiVJMmRIzA==)

| **Earlier this Summer, Defend Our Courts launched our Unpack Our Courts initiative** , the campaign to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court. We are building the political momentum for SCOTUS reform so that when Democrats retake power, we can move swiftly to save our Democracy.
---
| _But first, we have to win big this November._ Democrats need to run the numbers up so high that Trump's election rigging attempts crumble, and win as many seats as possible to build the majorities we need in Congress, so we're ready to get things done the moment we win back the White House in 2028.

## SCOTUS Blocks Trump Mail Ballot Plan
The Supreme Court on Monday rejected the [Trump administration's attempt](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOmzAQhp_GbI7OxuAweKhUsaXq1hEZ-0guNRjZR6K8fUVeofN9-nTf_-c23Twl2u6__IqOlzxt-K4JmbFMNWQ-6pxy-Fu5HOu-J7_NlNKkQfcSBqm6yQemF07GN9EtiBrbBp2y18H0vYWheTgLsY2zN7OaZ0AdYekGs0Sj0Nt2GWJD7vTBoDoF0MH1YkD1PugOrmgN2EEYwEicy-WZaeMHLumTX1guIa9Ncg_mvYr2h9Cj0KOfw9lw3oQef-dETKEKPdZjL7iiDPkoLAs-MXCV3zDp40obVS6eKW9VemZc95OqXCiwXD2l08G5fEQ7UhTtT9X2xmhjbVNc3N-UEtXeCgP3k_4-x_-56cvpfwEAAP__wT6OtA) to enforce new U.S. Postal Service restrictions on mail-in ballots before the midterm elections, keeping a lower court's nationwide injunction in place. The blocked rule would have required states to [submit voter lists](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unTAQhJ8GOiNj_AOFizR0N21KZMxyz54sGNkLJG8fcV4h9WhG832_vqavgIT798-wgec1TTvchYAZ8lRi4rPMlOLvwvncjoPCPiPRpKSyQg6iNVOIjBdMOtSLXwEUdDX41vWDttbJoX75QRob-0Ebqzvt1tZ0ysqg1BJcZ3oHNfpnTw6taaU0sm-0bG2IysgenJZuqLSEBTnl5p1w5xes9DddkJuYtpr8i_koVfejUmOlxvu-mzX9eTievFLjkQgZY6nUWM4jwwYipjOzyPCGyEV84MSMi8hw4QWicMbIYgtIYg5EiUU-CYqYYU0ZxIYLQ95Knf1y3EiExbpKy--n8XnF_ynz8upfAAAA__-5i4zR) and use federally reviewed barcodes on ballot envelopes. Postal workers would have only delivered ballots to voters appearing on the state-provided list. Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas dissented. Justice Brett Kavanaugh [sided with the majority](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO3CAQBeDT4I4VYIyhoEjj7k-b0sJ4WPNnbCwY7yq3j7w5QupPM3rv_fqav0LGfDx_hh08pTIf8G4IRFDnFgtdbcESfzeq136eGI4lI85KKMOF43KYQ6T8glmHbvUJQEHfgZejddqYUbhu86CskcOqUkopJtdbqYyRISzOjjpY22V__xNODlKIQdiHFtKEqAZhYdRidEwLWDOV-vgu-aANEv4pL6iPWPYO_UZ0Ntb_YGpiaqINtox4G1NTheeFgXI5mJpiuSrxJRAhNKYmI6zrteXtOivswP95hW-I1PinMt9DRr4ExEL3SVf9er4zYm5mZFo8b__koP-c7-XV3wAAAP__JgWGSg) but cited the timing, less than two months before Election Day, for his decision rather than the rule's legality. With mail voting already underway in several states, the ruling ensures ballots will be delivered as planned this fall, with the legal fight effectively punted to 2028.
## Downed US Airman Reveals Details of Rescue
An Air Force officer shot down over Iran in April described his 50-hour fight to survive in his [first public interview](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAYhJ8GO8wvIkpBsY3d2XZLg_hzzr-LYAA1-_Y33le43SSTmcl8f17Ly1Kg-P5tdzTVpyXiXQLWinkpLtWzrCG5f6Xmcz-OYONKISwChOKgeTcs1lW6cJG22YxHFNg3aLpx0lKpEXTzMWoTVk_g9DBBj7aDDf062H7cevQSdUPm6QPdDR3AAFMroVPWiQEmHCWMmknAjWrK7d9EsX7Qh__pwty6tDfBfGo9Cut_MTEzMd_33bq1PD8en4n5kUzMGYs7Kb75mu2VuKXMfcoOefKeHGZO2UaugO8Uz4pPpMlmO24KgYoamYT3bil8r9YfwrqM-AoAAP__aTuAWQ) Sunday. Identified only by his call sign, Bravo, he fell at up to 100 mph after an Iranian missile shredded his parachute. He prayed as he fell: _"Lord, your will be done. But if I'm getting through this, I need help."_ Bravo [broke his back](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSpCAQgOGnwcypFkE0ILjEbC690GKwGfu2BQvQqXn7rdlX2Piv-oL_3325O2KKz79uR1tDWiK-CmOtmJfiUz3Lg5P_KjWf-3Gwiw9iXiTIoYWp7fTifKULF-Wa1QZEiX2DtjPjpIbBwNRstn-MUqMaV3CoPXrTaxi80mpSMgQ0DdmPB1OnOwAN401BNzgvNYxoFJhJKMCVasq3_4li3TDwO12Ybz7tDdut1qOI_o-Qs5Bz3XAj5k8Tcj4Sk38LOa8YMBYUch5gNL0y7VlcaH3iFJHbcuaLLiwtZRdbn13ZhJybbNfjRcxUBiMUPHdHP3JTfznrsvI7AAD__2kLfug), an arm, and a shoulder, then climbed a 7,000-foot ridgeline as Iranian forces came within a few hundred meters. His rescue led to the U.S. putting more than 90 troops on the ground in Iran for the first in 46 years, aided by a CIA [deception campaign](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0b_unDAMwPGngc2nkONPMjDcctuvQ5eOyAQDaU2CEgO6t6_4SX2Czh_rK1v-9TV8oWcflh-4US9zHAJdmUmE0pBdlCOPHN2fLOnY9p0xjJ550Eq3oCxUzYBO_ElDjeXUz0SaniX1VWds3badsuXaa1NjV42ms2imrtYWlRstEpkZURtT-v7uKVs1lVKNMo9aVS063ShDXa06W9SKJi8xPX5HH2SlmT_xpPRwcSu5X0X2XDxfhX4X-n1d12PL4bZCvynAkQv93o-RvYOMM8kHMExAG6WFgvN0-0rIsn7DvxmmJDehTzDH5Ahc5BiIIa9RYIpXgHsL8AkDJDoJOcNEeaeEQrAn_NwaoFGwxiPB7JdVQCLkI53-pDue4PXSzj7VzzL10355Zp_brqjVsqHn7xPlPz9z9vpvAAAA__96aaeR). When their planes got stuck in the desert sand, the rescue force destroyed the aircraft rather than leave them behind. Bravo was pulled out at sunrise on Easter Sunday, April 5. See [declassified rescue footage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ_G7o6FWfxDQZHG3aZNaWE4rE-CwQLWaN8-8r2PcKsZaaTRzPfnuT41eQqv3_pAVVxcA9bssRRMazaxvPPmo_mXS3of5-l12Mj7lTM-ApPQD6s2hS5chW6tcogcHy2qfpqlGMeJyXZX4zBYabTUo7DzA9EKKST2m2R22GYxt6TuPib7oWdsYHMnWD9qwwc24yTYJBvB0FKJqfsbKZQdnf_EC1Nn4tF6tZdy5ubxq-FLw5daa2e2fP-484Yvt_0W_wGLxuucyRFauMhizJD3WKHsCEc8MJQMNtaAFjQlcDEZhOgcGUwZKiaEhNm80QIFoKRDw5c2KXtW8p7yODWCvQ5N_mte-SHVS_H_AQAA__-sXpA_) here.
## List: Richest Celebrity Billionaires
Steven Spielberg is the world's richest celebrity, worth an estimated $7.1 billion, according to a [new ranking](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OrDAQhE8DGagxvw4cvIRsXrohauxm6B2Dkd0Dmtuv2CtsWipV6fu-HtMD2fP-_I8bGVnCtNOVPIlQnJIN8k6zD_aVJL634_C4z-z9pEB1Beiiaie0widNDebOLESK6pxM1Q-66boedL4aVesaHS26dXM7aIu6qrratW6ugQC7nM29B7pqK4AWhrKBqkOrWhiob6DXWQPkWEIsvwPvstLiP-GkWNqw5d6sIkfK6n-ZGjM1XtdVnpze6C0eLOg5yV3M1Bhxf5ErZKXiCtG7VES2KyUpLHmaI8unuPk47MiRUqbGPBp3XHeWuj5r4Lkh-99f-aOu06ifAAAA__8Q-oKI) of the wealthiest stars. Fellow director George Lucas, creator of _Star Wars_ , is second at $5.2 billion. Spielberg became entertainment's first billionaire in 1994 after _Jurassic Park_ , and his fortune now spans DreamWorks and royalties on Universal theme park tickets. Michael Jordan is the richest athlete, with a net worth of $4.3 billion, built largely on Nike endorsement money. He [sold his majority stake](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ8GOqPF_BgXLtLQXdqUaMHLsRdjI9t36PL0EXmFtDPSjL7v6zbdkB37-yfuZPIaJk9ncpQzxSktIT_T7MLynXJ87sfh0M_s3CRB9gK0qLsJl8wvmlosrVmJJDUlmVoNuu17BbrcjGpgUDTXerUN1K2WtlE4NFbJVXdooWRz7YGuuxqgg6Fqoe5xkR0MpFpQumiBLOcQq0dgnzda3Tu8KFZL2EtntpyPVDQfhRwLOZ7nWfkZr66Q44VTyHHnZUNy4hGiRZ9EQkcirGLHR4ic3yKcnmLa-LjSLURPOYmVPTr-IVtGY4-TnePUq6KF-47s_t7zP6W9jPwNAAD__yXHg8g) in the Charlotte Hornets in 2023. JAY-Z leads the musicians at $2.8 billion. Taylor Swift follows at $2 billion, powered by the highest-grossing tour in music history. ---
THE BIG
MURKOWSKI
Anchorage. Primary day. No ID required.
This investigation cost **$50,000**. [Help us fund the next one.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuOrDAMhp8mdKCQEC5FiiMhujntlsgkBiIIiXKZef0Vs5pquy39-_MvffLXY36AOc21_QeLMqR1DnFOu4k7xAWVswgeUsJwzYyytqRDWYsZVDJPnBsotNRKQ60KlHXXD03bM9YWu-z5oEXXg6C8Qyo0HwR0gIKtwPiieWHk3UeHWtSUUyYqqjQV_aAGsUBDOZKGwokhVQF9Xk6j4EoQj9UFhZVytjjlnpKPhP8jbCJsiqhywAou1C7dBGGTOxBXtKgNbMFlf0d2KxezlTaHw73iYUq7lN55IHzKyc7R5aCQ8PEXSFh7A3dbtoSP76OfTIH1YLaL8PGj9dm4K-GVCB9DWglrwbr8HrkogtT-Zc7TxLYjDd0smPOtlv7wiadk3wEAAP__I9-aNA)
Dear Patriot,
Stand at that table with me for a second. Anchorage, Alaska. Primary day. There is a folding table, a laminated binder, and a perfectly nice woman working the poll book the way she probably has for years. I give her a name. It is not my name. The name is **Brian Murkowski**. He is the brother of a sitting United States Senator. He does not live in Alaska. He lives in Texas.
[ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuOrDAMhp8mdKCQEC5FiiMhujntlsgkBiIIiXKZef0Vs5pquy39-_MvffLXY36AOc21_QeLMqR1DnFOu4k7xAWVswgeUsJwzYyytqRDWYsZVDJPnBsotNRKQ60KlHXXD03bM9YWu-z5oEXXg6C8Qyo0HwR0gIKtwPiieWHk3UeHWtSUUyYqqjQV_aAGsUBDOZKGwokhVQF9Xk6j4EoQj9UFhZVytjjlnpKPhP8jbCJsiqhywAou1C7dBGGTOxBXtKgNbMFlf0d2KxezlTaHw73iYUq7lN55IHzKyc7R5aCQ8PEXSFh7A3dbtoSP76OfTIH1YLaL8PGj9dm4K-GVCB9DWglrwbr8HrkogtT-Zc7TxLYjDd0smPOtlv7wiadk3wEAAP__I9-aNA)
Then I tell her the one thing that is supposed to stop all of this cold. I tell her **I do not have my ID.** She looks up at me and says:
| "Absolutely possible."
---
ANCHORAGE POLL WORKER * AUGUST 18, 2026
I want you to watch this one for yourself. And then I want you to help me pay for the next one. **[You can chip in right here.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuOrDAMhp8mdKCQEC5FiiMhujntlsgkBiIIiXKZef0Vs5pquy39-_MvffLXY36AOc21_QeLMqR1DnFOu4k7xAWVswgeUsJwzYyytqRDWYsZVDJPnBsotNRKQ60KlHXXD03bM9YWu-z5oEXXg6C8Qyo0HwR0gIKtwPiieWHk3UeHWtSUUyYqqjQV_aAGsUBDOZKGwokhVQF9Xk6j4EoQj9UFhZVytjjlnpKPhP8jbCJsiqhywAou1C7dBGGTOxBXtKgNbMFlf0d2KxezlTaHw73iYUq7lN55IHzKyc7R5aCQ8PEXSFh7A3dbtoSP76OfTIH1YLaL8PGj9dm4K-GVCB9DWglrwbr8HrkogtT-Zc7TxLYjDd0smPOtlv7wiadk3wEAAP__I9-aNA)** I asked her again anyway, because I wanted it recorded and I wanted it to be completely unmistakable to anyone who watched it later. All I have to do is fill out the question ballot, and then I can vote? **" Yes, sir."** We titled the video **" The Big Murkowski,"** and you really do have to laugh a little bit at it, because the only other available option is putting your head through a wall.
The funny part ends fast. **Every single thing I am about to tell you makes the thing before it worse.**
| ONE. A total stranger walked in off the street carrying no identification of any kind and was offered a ballot. TWO. The name on that ballot belongs to a United States Senator's brother who lives roughly three thousand miles away, in another state entirely. THREE. We did it again. Different polling place, same morning. One of my reporters gave the name **Karina Waller** -- Senator Murkowski's own **State Director**. No ID. Same offer. **[Help us keep doing exactly this.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuOrDAMhp8mdKCQEC5FiiMhujntlsgkBiIIiXKZef0Vs5pquy39-_MvffLXY36AOc21_QeLMqR1DnFOu4k7xAWVswgeUsJwzYyytqRDWYsZVDJPnBsotNRKQ60KlHXXD03bM9YWu-z5oEXXg6C8Qyo0HwR0gIKtwPiieWHk3UeHWtSUUyYqqjQV_aAGsUBDOZKGwokhVQF9Xk6j4EoQj9UFhZVytjjlnpKPhP8jbCJsiqhywAou1C7dBGGTOxBXtKgNbMFlf0d2KxezlTaHw73iYUq7lN55IHzKyc7R5aCQ8PEXSFh7A3dbtoSP76OfTIH1YLaL8PGj9dm4K-GVCB9DWglrwbr8HrkogtT-Zc7TxLYjDd0smPOtlv7wiadk3wEAAP__I9-aNA)** FOUR. Alaska law says you show identification to get a ballot, and the one narrow exception written into it is that the poll worker personally knows the person standing in front of them. Nobody in either of those buildings had ever laid eyes on us before in their lives. FIVE. Nobody wrote anything down. Nobody picked up a phone. Nobody flagged a single thing. We asked, we got our answer, and we walked back out the door.
---
Now here is the part that should stop you cold. Senator Murkowski has spent this year fighting the SAVE Act, which her office describes as "an overly burdensome, one-size-fits-all mandate from Washington," and the argument underneath that position has always been the same one we hear everywhere: that the hole we keep describing does not actually exist outside of our imagination. **We just showed her the hole. In her own state. Using her own brother's name.** Before anyone calls this a partisan hit job, let me say it plainly: Senator Murkowski is a Republican, and it does not matter to me even a little, because a hole in the process is a hole in the process and it does not care one bit about which party happens to walk through it. Her office did not say they were going to fix it. Her office said this:
| "Voter impersonation is a crime and should be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law." OFFICE OF SEN. LISA MURKOWSKI

name: The Democratic Party
subject: Happy National Voter Registration Day!
body:
Here’s your checklist for the day:
---
Happy National Voter Registration Day, Derek! This is a huge day for us. With the deadline to register to vote approaching fast in many states, the DNC and our _When We Count_ fellows are running the LARGEST-EVER voter registration push in the history of our Party. Republicans have dominated voter registration in recent years. That’s why one of the DNC’s top priorities in 2026 has been registering tens of thousands of young Democrats to vote in battleground states like Arizona and Nevada. **In some of these communities, Democrats are now _out-registering_ Republicans** In 2024, the House majority was decided by just over _7,000 votes_ , so every new Democratic voter we register in a swing district could shape the balance of power in Congress. [**If registering that make-or-break voter sounds worth it to you, we’re asking you to celebrate National Voter Registration Day by chipping in $7 to the DNC today to help us continue registering new Democrats and win nationwide →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=7&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
| **[Donate $32](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=32&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $50](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
| **[Donate $100](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?express_lane=true&amount=250&refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&refcode2=9158_22930333_shHbB1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1)**
---
****
If you’re not in a position to contribute, we completely understand. Trump’s economy has punished millions of families — we know times are hard, and there are so many other ways to make an impact on this election. **Here are a couple of other ways you can celebrate Voter Registration Day with us:**
✅ **Get involved in your community!** Click [here](https://ak.democrats.org/go/63614?refcode=em_20260915_9158_fr&t=1&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1) to volunteer and check out events near Cresco where you can connect with Democrats in your community.
✅ **Get your family to double-check their voter registration status** to make sure you all are ready to vote this fall. You can visit [iwillvote.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/8151?t=2&akid=9158%2E22930333%2EshHbB1) to check your voter registration status and learn about how to vote in Cresco.
You are the bedrock of this movement, and we are so grateful for everything you do.
Thank you, thank you, thank you.
Team DNC

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

name: Chris Deluzio
subject: Will I run against John Fetterman?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Over the past few weeks, there's been a lot of speculation about whether or not I will run against John Fetterman in 2028.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=92%2E42639%2EUC_nii)
Willis -
Over the past few weeks, there's been a lot of speculation about whether or not I will run for the Senate seat in 2028 that John Fetterman currently holds.
It's getting to the point where I am being asked about it in almost every interview. I get it. A lot of people are talking about Senator Fetterman's constant appearances bashing Democrats on Fox News, his joint fundraising committee with a Republican Senator, his video appearance at the Republican midterm convention and more.
And for Democrats, I can understand why people who volunteered for John, donated to John, who thought they were going to get something completely different from John are upset, disappointed, and looking for someone to do something about it.
I get it. I get it. I get it.
Let me say this.
We are just about six weeks away from the most consequential midterm election in quite some time.
At stake is nothing less than whether or not we are going to take back the House and Senate and put a check on the most dangerous president in modern American history.
Today in America, we have more wealth and income inequality than at any time since the 1920s. We spend more money per person on health care, yet get worse results than just about every advanced country in the world. Families cannot afford to spend time with their newborn children or take care of a loved one when they are sick and need help. And we have a corrupt system of campaign finance where the wealthiest are able to buy elections to keep the status quo in place.
All of that is at stake.
For me, I have my own House race and as the last Democrat in Pennsylvania who represents a battleground seat, I am taking that seriously. I also understand the importance of helping Democrats across Pennsylvania in their own tough races — because we need to do more than just hold my seat.
So let me say this:
John Fetterman is not going to be a Senator after 2028.
So remember what he's done. File it away. And come back to it when this election is over.
But for now, it's important for all of us to do what we can to win in 2026. And I need your help in my race.
**[Can you please make a contribution to my re-election campaign to Congress in Pennsylvania? Our average online donation is around $30. Many give more. Some give less. Give what you can, it will all add up and we’ll win this race in November and Democrats will take back the House.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q3.tyfWFC&refcode=em260915&t=2&akid=92%2E42639%2EUC_nii)**

subject: Our Constitution is at risk
body:
This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2LpDAQhn9NvCn50KgHD83YLgvb-0Ef9hjSqdIuNiZi4izz7xdhBvY813qLh6rn_X0zN0uewvLdrjhQSgYimHjsLoaUKR-ZYqBk807pj5Fc6pL3pWiMdZle0dS2gKGRopu7AgfRdn3dqk7z4jnM0Dw6i7PAdrailq3WoCXoh27mB-8fBQ0nj_eiEZLXoq-01o2cFbS25yDmmtX82MBmrCgkAkwuxm2LnjK5VMV9KfzwzHlLTF2YnJicErpjx-pJ3iewHiuEg8kJYrAZmZz-_6oE-1aeFzA1JVxWDPklAjI1ciVEd-F8erldv4w_xuv1zqQ-8mrSaeZc2faYNnSZwvIerQh0rEyNuFry70Nn183SEpgaXQwG7NtHEEPGkJkav_28CPOrLb_e7-WHj2IfYPtL3lPSLav5ciIrF9cif66j10H-CwAA___oY6Ij)

| | Dear Fellow American, This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited. The signers of that document pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor in its defense. The Declaration’s principles are the foundation of our Constitution, which was signed 239 years ago on September 17, 1787. **But today, many of our fellow citizens reject the principles of the Declaration and seek a radical transformation of the Constitution—putting the liberty of all Americans at risk.** This means there is much work to be done on the battlefield of education. And that’s why your support is urgently needed. [I hope you’ll join 500 fellow Americans in defending the principles of the Declaration and the Constitution by becoming a **_Liberty & Learning Society_** member.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2LpDAQhn9NvCn50KgHD83YLgvb-0Ef9hjSqdIuNiZi4izz7xdhBvY813qLh6rn_X0zN0uewvLdrjhQSgYimHjsLoaUKR-ZYqBk807pj5Fc6pL3pWiMdZle0dS2gKGRopu7AgfRdn3dqk7z4jnM0Dw6i7PAdrailq3WoCXoh27mB-8fBQ0nj_eiEZLXoq-01o2cFbS25yDmmtX82MBmrCgkAkwuxm2LnjK5VMV9KfzwzHlLTF2YnJicErpjx-pJ3iewHiuEg8kJYrAZmZz-_6oE-1aeFzA1JVxWDPklAjI1ciVEd-F8erldv4w_xuv1zqQ-8mrSaeZc2faYNnSZwvIerQh0rEyNuFry70Nn183SEpgaXQwG7NtHEEPGkJkav_28CPOrLb_e7-WHj2IfYPtL3lPSLav5ciIrF9cif66j10H-CwAA___oY6Ij) And when you join the **_Liberty & Learning Society_** with a monthly gift of $18.44 or more, I’ll send you a leather-bound edition of _The U.S. Constitution: A Reader_ —published by Hillsdale College and used by our students—as a special thank-you for your support. America’s Founders understood that liberty cannot endure without a citizenry educated in the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. This is the kind of education Hillsdale provides—and it is needed more urgently than ever. **If liberty is to endure for the next 250 years, we must teach future generations about the principles that make it possible.** [You can help by joining the **_Liberty & Learning Society_** today.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2LpDAQhn9NvCn50KgHD83YLgvb-0Ef9hjSqdIuNiZi4izz7xdhBvY813qLh6rn_X0zN0uewvLdrjhQSgYimHjsLoaUKR-ZYqBk807pj5Fc6pL3pWiMdZle0dS2gKGRopu7AgfRdn3dqk7z4jnM0Dw6i7PAdrailq3WoCXoh27mB-8fBQ0nj_eiEZLXoq-01o2cFbS25yDmmtX82MBmrCgkAkwuxm2LnjK5VMV9KfzwzHlLTF2YnJicErpjx-pJ3iewHiuEg8kJYrAZmZz-_6oE-1aeFzA1JVxWDPklAjI1ciVEd-F8erldv4w_xuv1zqQ-8mrSaeZc2faYNnSZwvIerQh0rEyNuFry70Nn183SEpgaXQwG7NtHEEPGkJkav_28CPOrLb_e7-WHj2IfYPtL3lPSLav5ciIrF9cif66j10H-CwAA___oY6Ij) I hope you’ll stand with Hillsdale College as we defend the principles of liberty in America’s 250th anniversary year. Warm regards,Larry P. Arnn

clean_body: This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited. This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Fellow American, This year, we marked the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, which makes clear that our rights are inalienable and the government ought to be limited. The signers of that document pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor in its defense. The Declaration’s principles are the foundation of our Constitution, which was signed 239 years ago on September 17, 1787. But today, many of our fellow citizens reject the principles of the Declaration and seek a radical transformation of the Constitution—putting the liberty of all Americans at risk. This means there is much work to be done on the battlefield of education. And that’s why your support is urgently needed. And when you join the Liberty & Learning Society with a monthly gift of $18.44 or more, I’ll send you a leather-bound edition of The U.S. Constitution: A Reader —published by Hillsdale College and used by our students—as a special thank-you for your support. America’s Founders understood that liberty cannot endure without a citizenry educated in the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. This is the kind of education Hillsdale provides—and it is needed more urgently than ever. If liberty is to endure for the next 250 years, we must teach future generations about the principles that make it possible. I hope you’ll stand with Hillsdale College as we defend the principles of liberty in America’s 250th anniversary year. Warm regards,Larry P.
